reasons.statement: The exact proposed pytest 9.1.1 resolution was exercised successfully across Python 3.11–3.14 through the lock-backed latest tox environments.
The official breaking behavior requires --doctest-modules, which the frozen repository does not use.
The listed deprecated pytest surfaces are absent or used in a supported form, including concrete Collection parametrization values.
No remaining target-specific pytest 9.1 uncertainty identifies a useful additional check.

limitations: Network S3 tests were excluded from the public matrix.
External pytest plugin internals were not independently audited.
Negative source search is bounded and does not prove universal absence outside the repository.
The recommendation is decision support, not proof that the update is safe.

transition_rules.condition: new evidence identifies a listed pytest 9.1 surface in the frozen path or a relevant failure
head SHA, dependency resolution, workflow command, or test selection changes
ordinary maintainer review finds no repository-policy blocker
